content: <thought>Based on the ¹H NMR data, the compound is a para‑disubstituted benzene with a methoxy group (singlet at 3.81 ppm) and a –CH₂‑CH₂‑COOCH₃ side chain (two triplets at 2.58 and 2.84 ppm, each integrating to 2H). This matches methyl 4‑methoxyphenylpropionate, whose SMILES is COc1ccc(cc1)CCC(=O)OC.
